annotation.justification: The phrase 'during the TLS handshake' is insufficiently precise. It could mean at any point during the entire handshake, or specifically in the initial handshake messages. This difference affects how an implementer would satisfy the requirement.
annotation.missing_information: The clause does not specify *when* during the TLS handshake the domain name must be indicated. This affects implementation because some mechanisms might not be available at all stages of the handshake.
